question: Identify an element that does NOT belong to period 4.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lithium**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Lithium** is an element that does not belong to period 4 of the periodic table.
 
• Lithium is placed in **period 2** of the periodic table and is part of the alkali metals group.
 
• Elements like **Calcium, Zinc, and Potassium** are all found in period 4 of the periodic table.
 
• Period 4 of the periodic table contains elements with atomic numbers from 19 to 36.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Periodic Table**

 
 
• The periodic table is a tabular arrangement of chemical elements, organized by their atomic number, electron configuration, and recurring chemical properties.
 
• Elements are presented in order of increasing atomic number in rows called periods and columns called groups.
 
• The table provides a framework for analyzing chemical behavior and is widely used in chemistry and other sciences.
 
 
 
• **Period 4 Elements**
 
 
• Period 4 elements include Potassium (K), Calcium (Ca), Scandium (Sc), Titanium (Ti), Vanadium (V), Chromium (Cr), Manganese (Mn), Iron (Fe), Cobalt (Co), Nickel (Ni), Copper (Cu), Zinc (Zn), Gallium (Ga), Germanium (Ge), Arsenic (As), Selenium (Se), Bromine (Br), and Krypton (Kr).
 
• These elements have their outermost electrons in the fourth shell.
 
 
 
• **Alkali Metals**
 
 
• Alkali metals are found in group 1 of the periodic table and include Lithium (Li), Sodium (Na), Potassium (K), Rubidium (Rb), Cesium (Cs), and Francium (Fr).
 
• They are highly reactive, especially with water, and are characterized by having one electron in their outermost shell.
 
 
 
• **Electronic Configuration**
 
 
• The electronic configuration of an element describes the distribution of electrons in its atomic orbitals.
 
• The configuration follows the Aufbau principle, Hund's rule, and the Pauli exclusion principle.
 
• For example, the electronic configuration of Lithium is 1s² 2s¹.
